items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Billy Minor had a good band around there, you know. And that's where Inge came from. That's where we got Inge, from Billy Minor's band.

ctx.x: That was him. A very good saxophone player.

And, you know, around Detroit they had a lot of good bands. When I was there at McKinney's band, they had a lot of good bands. Billy Minor had a good band around there, you know. And that's where Inge came from. That's where we got Inge, from Billy Minor's band.
